raw_intent: The Clarity Engine may need a durable context layer so coding agents can ground vague human intent before drafting a Mission Packet.
human_context: Clarity Engine already produces deterministic PCP-lite Mission Packets.
constraints: Do not build a general-purpose context platform.
desired_direction: Preserve raw thought first, then ground it before mission drafting.
assumptions: A read-oriented MCP interface can make captured intent available to coding agents.
clarifications_needed: Which context sources are required before an intent is ready for mission drafting?
